consequence.statement: The added spec.ruleContext[] field is described as optional in the kyverno.io/v2 schema, so no existing or newly applied UpdateRequest resource is rejected and nothing stops being honoured; the field is simply newly available.

assertion.statement: The kyverno.io/v2 UpdateRequest schema gained the new optional list field spec.ruleContext[] (items with rule, synchronize, deleteDownstream and a trigger object carrying apiVersion, kind, name, namespace and uid), computed as added between Kyverno 1.12.6 and 1.13.0.
